## Service: users (Users API v3)

Documentation for users API

**API Version v3**

All APIs available via `/v3` route prefix with AIP-compliant responses.

### Create User
POST /users/
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/users/
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/users/create-user | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/users/create-user.md

Auth (any one of):
- Agency token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: users.write
- Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: users.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Request body (required) (application/json) CreateUserDto:
- companyId* string (e.g. "ve9EPM428h8vShlRW1KT") - Company/Agency ID to associate the user with
- email* string (e.g. "john@deo.com") - Email address of the user (used for login)
- password* string (e.g. "************") - Password for the user account. All passwords will be required to meet the following criteria: - Minimum 12 characters - At least one uppercase letter (A–Z) - At least one lowercase letter (a–z) - At least one number (0–9) - At least one special character (e.g., !, @, #, $)
- phone string (e.g. "+18832327657") - Phone number of the user in E.164 format
- type* string (e.g. "account") - User account type (account for sub-account users, agency for agency-level users)
- role* string (e.g. "admin") - User role within the account (admin or user)
- locationIds* string[] (e.g. ["C2QujeCh8ZnC7al2InWR"]) - List of location IDs to assign to the user
- permissions object - User permissions controlling access to various features

- profilePhoto string (e.g. "https://img.png") - URL of the user profile photo
- twilioPhone map<string, string> - Per-location inbound Twilio number in E.164 format, keyed by location id (Call and Voicemail Inbound Number for direct Twilio, not LC Phone). Replacement semantics: if you send twilioPhone in the request body, the stored map is replaced entirely with this object (not merged). Any location id omitted from the object is removed from the saved map. Omit the twilioPhone property entirely to leave existing numbers unchanged. Send an empty object {} to clear all per-location numbers. To clear a single location only, set that location id to an empty string "".

- lastName* string (e.g. "Deo") - Last name of the user

### Delete User
DELETE /users/{userId}
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/users/{userId}
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/users/delete-user | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/users/delete-user.md

Auth (any one of):
- Agency token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: users.write
- Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: users.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Response 200 (Successful response) application/json:
- succeeded boolean - Indicates whether the user deletion was queued successfully
- message string - Message describing the result of the deletion request

Errors: 400, 401, 422 (400, 401, 422: see Common error responses)

### Filter Users by Email
POST /users/search/filter-by-email
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/users/search/filter-by-email
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/users/filter-users-by-email | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/users/filter-users-by-email.md

Filter users by company ID, deleted status, and email array

Auth: Agency token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: users.readonly

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Request body (required) (application/json) FilterByEmailDto:
- companyId* string (e.g. "5DP41231LkQsiKESj6rh") - Company ID to filter users
- emails* string (e.g. "user1@example.com,user2@example.com") - Comma-separated list of email addresses to filter users
- deleted boolean (default: false) - Filter deleted users
- skip string (default: 0; e.g. "1") - No of results to be skipped before returning the result
- limit string (default: 25; e.g. "10") - No of results to be limited before returning the result
- projection string (e.g. "all") - Projection fields to return. Use "all" for all fields, or specify comma-separated field names. Default returns only id and email

Response 200 (Successful response) application/json:
- users object[] - List of users matching the search criteria
  - id string - Unique identifier of the user
  - name string - Full name of the user
  - firstName string - First name of the user
  - lastName string - Last name of the user
  - email string - Email address of the user
  - phone string - Phone number of the user
  - extension string - Phone extension of the user
  - permissions object - User permissions controlling access to various features
    - campaignsEnabled boolean (default: true) - Whether campaigns are enabled for this user
    - campaignsReadOnly boolean (default: false) - Whether campaigns are in read-only mode for this user
    - contactsEnabled boolean (default: true) - Whether contacts are enabled for this user
    - workflowsEnabled boolean (default: true) - Whether workflows are enabled for this user
    - workflowsReadOnly boolean (default: false) - Whether workflows are in read-only mode for this user
    - triggersEnabled boolean (default: true) - Whether triggers are enabled for this user
    - funnelsEnabled boolean (default: true) - Whether funnels are enabled for this user

### Search Users
GET /users/search
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/users/search
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/users/search-users | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/users/search-users.md

Auth (any one of):
- Agency token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: users.readonly
- Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: users.readonly

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Query parameters:
- companyId* string (e.g. "5DP41231LkQsiKESj6rh") - Company ID in which the search needs to be performed
- query string (e.g. "John") - The search term for the user is matched based on the user full name, email or phone
- skip string (default: 0; e.g. "1") - No of results to be skipped before returning the result
- limit string (default: 25; e.g. "10") - No of results to be limited before returning the result
- locationId string (e.g. "5DP41231LkQsiKESj6rh") - Location ID in which the search needs to be performed
- type string (e.g. "agency") - Type of the users to be filtered in the search
- role string (e.g. "admin") - Role of the users to be filtered in the search
- ids string (e.g. "5DP4iH6HLkQsiKESj6rh,5DP4iH6HLkQsiKESj34h") - List of User IDs to be filtered in the search
- sort string (e.g. "dateAdded") - The field on which sort is applied in which the results need to be sorted. Default is based on the first and last name
- sortDirection string (e.g. "asc") - The direction in which the results need to be sorted
- enabled2waySync boolean - Filter users by whether 2-way sync is enabled

Response 200 (Successful response) application/json:

- profilePhoto string (e.g. "https://img.png") - URL of the user profile photo
- twilioPhone map<string, string> - Per-location inbound Twilio number in E.164 format, keyed by location id (Call and Voicemail Inbound Number for direct Twilio, not LC Phone). Replacement semantics: if you send twilioPhone in the request body, the stored map is replaced entirely with this object (not merged). Any location id omitted from the object is removed from the saved map. Omit the twilioPhone property entirely to leave existing numbers unchanged. Send an empty object {} to clear all per-location numbers. To clear a single location only, set that location id to an empty string "".
